sections.title: Request and Routing Facts
sections.purpose: Capture claimed demand and observable routing facts without asking the requester to select the result. Authenticated submission provenance is added by the publishing service, not typed into this form.

fields.label: First: does this belong in the existing service catalog?
fields.help: General Inquiry is a normal service request. Work Proposal intake begins only after this boundary is tested.
options: I need an expert answer or brief feasibility guidance
I need an existing, documented service or standard change
I am proposing new or materially changed work

fields.label: Expected expert time (hours)
fields.help: This demo treats up to four hours, with no change or purchase, as General Inquiry.

fields.label: Would answering this require someone to change a system?
Requester named in this draft
fields.help: Name the person who knowingly asks the organization to act. This field is a claim, not authentication; the publishing service records the authenticated actor separately.

fields.label: Work Sponsor
fields.help: A name alone is not sponsorship; acceptance must be tied to this proposal revision.

fields.label: Does this draft claim sponsor acceptance for this revision?
fields.help: This records an intake assertion only. The publishing service must obtain durable, attributable approval tied to this exact revision before it can mark sponsorship accepted.

fields.label: Acceptance Authority
fields.help: Who may decide that the delivered result satisfies the agreed proof and operating conditions?

fields.label: Primary intent
fields.help: One intent per Work Package; if two are required, split the work.

fields.label: Top-level outcome shape
fields.help: One independently valuable result produces an Epic; several produce an Initiative containing Epics.

fields.label: Does material Known Uncertainty remain?
fields.help: A substantive unknown creates bounded Discovery; Assisted Intake must stop before doing that work.

fields.label: People or customers affected
fields.help: Use the best defensible estimate.

fields.label: Operational Ownership
fields.help: Who will operate, support, maintain, and respond to failure after acceptance?

fields.label: Can customers experience the outcome or a failure?
Does it handle sensitive or regulated data?
Is it part of authentication or authorization?
Is any component exposed to the public internet?
Could this require a purchase or vendor commitment?
Potential financial commitment (USD)
fields.help: Financial Commitment Class is kept separate from delivery size and risk.

fields.label: Affected systems
fields.help: The system derives participating functions and dependency handoffs from this service map. Routing does not commit their capacity.

fields.label: Current labor forecast (person-days)
fields.help: A delivery estimate supplied or accepted by delivery reviewers; it is not requester-selected size.

fields.label: Current elapsed-duration forecast (weeks)
fields.help: This includes waiting and dependencies; it does not overwrite the Approved Delivery Baseline.

sections.title: Problem and Benefit
sections.purpose: Establish why any change is warranted before defining what the change should produce.
sections.completionEvidence: The unmet need or failure is stated in plain language, the current system's limitation is explicit, and the benefit connects solving the problem to an operating or business result.

fields.label: What problem does this solve that the existing system cannot solve?
fields.help: Describe the unmet need, failure, or opportunity in plain English. Name who experiences it and what the existing system cannot do; do not describe the proposed solution.
fields.placeholder: The current metrics platform cannot remain supported at the forecast workload, leaving SRE unable to preserve reliable alerting and long-term retention…

fields.label: What benefit does solving this problem create?
fields.help: Explain who benefits and how. Connect technical improvement to the operating or business result it protects or makes possible; a faster query or larger capacity is not a benefit by itself.
fields.placeholder: Reliable queries and alerts allow engineering teams to detect production failures before users are affected, while reducing recurring SRE work that displaces higher-value reliability improvements…

sections.title: Current-State Baseline
sections.purpose: Define the system that exists before proposing its replacement.
sections.completionEvidence: Architecture, workload, failure behavior, lifecycle, cost, operator effort, and the delta from any referenced baseline are explicit.

fields.label: How is Current State established?
fields.help: Reference an accepted revision only when its delta is explicit.
options: Reference an accepted baseline and state its delta
Define the Current State in this proposal

fields.label: Authoritative baseline reference
fields.help: Name the artifact, revision, acceptance date, and owner. Do not write ‘see existing documentation.’
fields.placeholder: OBS-ARCH-004 rev 7, accepted May 18, 2026 by SRE

fields.label: Architecture and operating path
fields.help: Name the live components, quantities, locations, connections, owners, and traffic or data path relevant to this request.
fields.placeholder: 38 collectors receive Prometheus-format metrics from 16 clusters…

fields.label: Measured production workload
fields.help: Give the observation window, units, sustained behavior, percentiles, maxima, and the retained source. State ‘not measured’ when Discovery must establish it.
fields.placeholder: May 1–28: 640,000 sustained samples/s; 910,000 p95… Source: OBS-WORKLOAD-2026-05.

fields.label: Observed failure, lifecycle, cost, and operator effort
fields.help: Record actual behavior: support dates, capacity horizon, recovery evidence, incidents, recurring labor, and current cost. Do not turn a suspected cause into a fact.
fields.placeholder: The release leaves vendor support on… SRE spends 56 person-hours/month…

fields.label: Explicit delta from the referenced baseline
fields.help: If the baseline remains current, say what was checked and that no material delta was found. Otherwise name every change relevant to this proposal.
fields.placeholder: Since rev 7, storage nodes were replaced like-for-like; topology and retention behavior are unchanged…

sections.title: Desired Outcome
sections.purpose: State one operating result, not a preferred implementation.
sections.completionEvidence: The operating scope, capability, decisive proof, and horizon are explicit.

fields.label: Who or what must experience the result?
fields.help: Name the population, services, sites, workloads, or operating boundary.
fields.placeholder: All 6,400 employees and contractors across 147 workforce applications…

fields.label: What must become true?
fields.help: Use product-neutral operating language. Include preserved behavior and the failure mode that disappears.
fields.placeholder: Northstar has selected a capability that preserves… without carrying forward…

fields.label: How will the organization know it is true?
fields.help: Name the decisive measures or observations. Detailed test steps belong in Acceptance Conditions.
fields.placeholder: The accepted query corpus passes and recurring operator work is ≤24 hours/month…

fields.label: For how long or by what event must it remain true?
fields.help: Use an operating horizon, contractual event, or sustained observation window—not an arbitrary project deadline.
fields.placeholder: Through the five-year planning horizon and a 30-day production burn-in…

sections.title: Feasibility Basis
sections.purpose: Establish that the required result does not exceed a physical, hardware, protocol, or procedural limit.
sections.completionEvidence: Every quantitative or time-bound Requirement and Acceptance Condition is covered by an identified Feasibility Basis with explicit hard limits, supporting evidence, assumptions, margin, and finding.

fields.label: Feasibility Bases
fields.help: Add one basis for each distinct target or group of targets supported by the same limits and evidence. Every SHALL, SHOULD, and Acceptance Condition identifier must be covered by at least one basis.

columns.label: Covered Requirement and Acceptance IDs
columns.help: Comma-separate stable identifiers, for example SHALL-001, SHALL-002, AC-001.
columns.placeholder: SHALL-001, SHALL-002, AC-001

columns.label: Which measurable target does this basis assess?
columns.placeholder: Sustain 1.74 million samples per second with 14.2 million active series…

columns.label: Which hard limits and irreducible steps apply?
columns.help: Identify physical distance, link rate, compute, storage, protocol, startup, reboot, cooling, or mandatory sequence limits. A nanosecond has a physical travel distance; if propagation alone consumes 54 ms, a 30 ms end-to-end target is impossible.
columns.placeholder: The fixed replay path is 10 Gb/s; serialization, propagation, and storage acknowledgement consume part of the latency budget…

columns.label: What evidence shows that the required result is achievable?
columns.help: Reference a representative demonstration, retained benchmark, calculation, decomposition, or independently reviewable model. A promise or vendor maximum is not evidence by itself.
columns.placeholder: OBS-REPLAY-017 generated and reconciled the target load through the fixed test path…

columns.label: Under which conditions does that evidence hold?
columns.placeholder: The replay preserves production encoding, cardinality, churn, query concurrency, and failure behavior…

columns.label: What margin remains between the target and the nearest limit?
columns.help: A target at the boundary has no operating margin and must not be presented as routine capacity.
columns.placeholder: The target remains 21% below the measured saturation point…

sections.title: Required Difference
sections.completionEvidence: Preserved obligations, changed conditions, and the common comparison evidence are explicit.

fields.label: What current contracts or outcomes must remain true?
fields.help: Name interfaces, behavior, data obligations, recovery promises, or authorization semantics that cannot be lost.
fields.placeholder: Prometheus remote-write, PromQL, dashboards, alert rules, and retention obligations…

fields.label: Which measured conditions must change?
fields.help: Pair each current limitation with the condition required instead. Do not say only ‘modernize,’ ‘improve,’ or ‘replace.’
fields.placeholder: Remove the March 31 support deadline, seven-month capacity horizon, and 56-hour monthly operating burden…

fields.label: What evidence must the decision compare?
fields.help: Name the production workload, failure behavior, operator exercise, cost model, retention obligation, or other common test basis.
fields.placeholder: The May workload replay, 50-query corpus, 8,420-rule corpus, failure scripts, and five-year lifecycle cost…

sections.title: Requirements, Acceptance Conditions, and Non-Goals
sections.purpose: Define what the result must do, how the organization will know, and what remains outside the boundary.

fields.label: Requirements
fields.help: One condition per row. Facts and buyer obligations use will; mandatory pass/fail conditions use shall; scored comparative goals use should. Every row names how it will be verified.

columns.label: Operating condition
columns.placeholder: The candidate shall ingest 1.74 million samples/s for 60 minutes…

columns.label: Verification method
columns.placeholder: Replay the retained May workload; reconcile sent, accepted, rejected, queued, and stored counts…

fields.label: Acceptance Conditions
fields.help: Record one independently assessable result per row. Describe observable proof of the Desired Outcome; acceptance is not ‘the implementation is complete,’ ‘documentation exists,’ or ‘a ticket was closed.’

columns.label: Condition or event
columns.placeholder: During loss of one availability zone under the accepted peak workload…

columns.label: Observable result
columns.placeholder: No acknowledged samples are lost and normal ingestion, query, and alert behavior returns within 30 minutes…

columns.label: Retained proof
columns.placeholder: Failure-test record with timestamps, reconciled counters, query results, and evaluator sign-off…

fields.label: Non-Goals
fields.help: Name adjacent work that a reasonable reader might otherwise assume is included. An exclusion is a boundary, not a parking lot for unresolved scope.

columns.label: Explicitly excluded change
columns.placeholder: This proposal will not change application instrumentation libraries, metric names, or dashboard ownership…

columns.label: Why it is outside this outcome
columns.placeholder: Those changes have separate owners and are not required to close the stated gap…

sections.title: Dependencies and Framing
sections.purpose: Separate prerequisites, reusable evidence, later work, and bounded Discovery from delivery authority.

fields.label: Required-by event and latest useful date
fields.help: Tie the date to a contract, renewal, capacity limit, compliance event, dependency window, or other observable condition.
fields.placeholder: Selection accepted by November 30, before the FY2027 renewal and storage-purchase window…

fields.label: Source of the timing condition
fields.help: Name the contract clause, forecast, calendar, accepted plan, or owner who can verify it.
fields.placeholder: Current support contract; 2.8% monthly growth forecast; Procurement renewal calendar…

fields.label: Which decision or outcome becomes unavailable?
fields.help: State the organizational consequence. ‘The project will be late’ is circular and supplies no priority evidence.
fields.placeholder: The organization loses the supported replacement window before March 31, 2027…

fields.label: What cost, risk, or obligation is created?
fields.help: Quantify the consequence where the evidence permits it.
fields.placeholder: $310,000 renewal plus another capacity expansion on the current architecture…

fields.label: What will the organization do if it misses the condition?
fields.help: Name the real fallback. If no decision has been made, say who must make it.
fields.placeholder: Procurement renews for one year and SRE expands the 730-day tier before the 90% limit…

fields.label: Non-catalog dependency evidence
fields.help: The catalog derives system ownership and dependency closure. Add only a prerequisite decision, contribution, commitment, external event, or hidden contract that it cannot derive. A dependency does not imply Capacity Acceptance.

columns.label: Dependency
columns.placeholder: Sanitized production-workload replay

columns.label: Fact or decision owner
columns.placeholder: SRE Observability Lead

columns.label: What must be supplied or decided?
columns.placeholder: Freeze the May 1–28 replay and measurement definitions before candidate testing begins…

columns.label: Existing commitment or source
columns.placeholder: OBS-WORKLOAD-2026-05 accepted by producing teams; no delivery capacity committed…

fields.label: Preconditions
fields.help: State conditions that must already be true before this work may start. Do not disguise implementation steps or preferred designs as prerequisites.

columns.label: Required prior fact or decision
columns.placeholder: Producing teams have accepted OBS-ARCH-004 rev 7 and the May workload export as accurate…

columns.label: Who proves it, and with what record?
columns.placeholder: SRE owns the signed baseline; Security owns replay-redaction approval…

fields.label: Stable artifact identifier
fields.help: Use the organization’s durable record name—not a Jira issue key generated later.
fields.placeholder: SEL-OBS-007

fields.label: Required contents
fields.help: Name the baseline, measurements, decisions, rejected options, residual uncertainty, and later acceptance contract the artifact must retain.
fields.placeholder: Versioned baseline and delta; workload dataset; requirement compliance; POC results; tradeoffs…

fields.label: What makes the artifact accepted rather than merely present?
fields.help: Name the required reconciliation, signatures, decision, or evidence closure.
fields.placeholder: Every SHALL has pass/fail/accepted-exception evidence and the Decision Owner records the selected and rejected options…

fields.label: What later work can now be framed?
fields.help: Name the next decision or Work Proposal, not a promise that implementation has been authorized.
fields.placeholder: A later Work Proposal can name the selected capability and split implementation into producer onboarding…

fields.label: Which accepted facts or decisions must not be reopened?
fields.help: Name the baseline, obligations, comparison, and boundaries that downstream work inherits.
fields.placeholder: Product selection, May workload, retention obligations, and the accepted failure tests…

fields.label: Decision-critical question
fields.help: Ask one question whose answer changes the design, option, boundary, or authorization decision.
fields.placeholder: Which option passes the accepted workload and failure tests at the lowest defensible lifecycle cost?

fields.label: Decision required when the timebox ends
fields.help: State the allowed dispositions even if evidence remains incomplete: proceed, reject, split, extend through a new decision, or accept residual uncertainty.
fields.placeholder: Select one option, reject all options, or authorize a separately bounded proof for a named residual uncertainty…

fields.label: Timebox phases
fields.help: Divide the timebox into evidence-producing phases. Each phase has an exit condition; elapsed time alone is not progress.

columns.label: Bounded phase and duration
columns.placeholder: 5 working days — freeze inputs and candidate claims

columns.label: Phase exit evidence
columns.placeholder: Versioned input package accepted; unresolved claims entered in the claim register

fields.label: Candidate independently valuable Epic outcomes
fields.help: Use only when the top-level outcome requires an Initiative. Each row states a capability or removed failure mode, its verification, and an operating horizon. These remain candidates, not authorized work.

columns.label: Capability or failure mode changed
columns.placeholder: The target tenant authenticates test users in both regions and survives primary-region isolation…

columns.label: Measure or decisive check
columns.placeholder: No more than five minutes of new-session interruption; security events export within five minutes…

columns.label: Operating horizon
columns.placeholder: 30-day burn-in after the migration wave…
